title: This AI Fact Checks Politicians Live
description:
Imagine getting live fact-checks while watching a political debate or interview.

This AI fact checker works in real time, listening to what's being said, checking claims against reliable sources, and showing supporting evidence within seconds. Instead of searching every statement yourself, you get instant context while the conversation is still happening.

The tool is called In Truth, a free browser extension designed to help you quickly verify claims made by politicians, public figures, and news interviews. Whether you're following elections, current events, or political discussions, it's a simple way to separate facts from misinformation.

In this video, you'll see how the AI fact checker works, what it can do, and why it's getting so much attention online.
